title.value: Few-shot Question Generation for Personalized Feedback in Intelligent Tutoring Systems
title.justification: The title directly reflects the primary focus and methodology used in the paper, which is few-shot question generation for personalized feedback.
title.quote: Few-shot Question Generation for Personalized Feedback in Intelligent Tutoring Systems

extractions.description: This paper explores the use of automatically generated questions as personalized feedback in Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS). It employs text similarity-based NLP Transformer models to identify correct and incorrect parts in student answers and uses few-shot Neural Question Generation models to guide students towards correct answers by addressing missing components in their responses. The model significantly enhances student learning outcomes in dialogue-based ITS.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is the development of personalized feedback mechanisms within Intelligent Tutoring Systems using deep learning, specifically for educational purposes, and does not directly relate to climate or ecological sustainability.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this work, we explore automatically generated questions as personalized feedback in an ITS.

primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily focused on education and intelligent tutoring systems rather than climate or ecological sustainability.
primary_category.quote: Our approach combines cause–effect analysis to break down student answers using text similarity-based NLP Transformer models to identify correct and incorrect or missing parts.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any secondary themes related to climate or ecological sustainability.
secondary_categories.quote: Existing work on generating hints in Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS) focuses mostly on manual and non-personalized feedback.

primary_sub_category.justification: There is no applicable sub-category related to climate or ecological sustainability in the focus of this paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: We train a few-shot Neural Question Generation and Question Re-ranking models to show questions addressing components missing in the student’s answers.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not cover secondary sub-categories related to climate or ecological sustainability.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Our personalized feedback can pinpoint correct and incorrect or missing phrases in student answers as well as guide them towards correct answer by asking a question in natural language.

applications.justification: The primary application discussed involves enhancing feedback mechanisms in Intelligent Tutoring Systems through personalized question generation.
applications.quote: Our personalized feedback can pinpoint correct and incorrect or missing phrases in student answers as well as guide them towards correct answer by asking a question in natural language.

new_primary_category.justification: The scope of the paper is best categorized under educational technology, which does not directly relate to any new or existing categories for sustainable development in climate or ecology.
new_primary_category.quote: Existing work on generating hints in Intelligent Tutoring Systems (ITS) focuses mostly on manual and non-personalized feedback.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not introduce a new concept relevant to climate or ecological categories, focusing instead on educational feedback.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Our model vastly outperforms both simple and strong baselines in terms of student learning gains by 45% and 23% respectively when tested in a real dialogue-based ITS.
